result.stdout:
USAGE:
    mcpclient.dll [arguments] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [arguments]    MCP Server Arguments (stdio only)

OPTIONS:
                           DEFAULT                                           
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                
        --logger           console    Logger (console or null)               
    -t, --transportType    stdio      MCP Server TransportType (stdio or sse)
    -l, --location                    MCP Server Location (sse only)         
    -c, --command                     MCP Server Command (stdio only)
